links.outcome: Accuracy of EHR-grounded chatbot sentences rated by clinicians; error severity
links.effect: Of 1225 sentences, 99.3% accurate; eight errors, all minor; Gwet's AC2 = 0.98 (95% CI 0.97-0.99).
links.quote: Of 1225 chatbot-generated sentences evaluated, 99.3% were accurate with all eight errors classified as minor (inter-rater reliability: Gwet's AC2, a chance-corrected inter-rater agreement coefficient, = 0.98; 95% CI, 0.97-0.99).

unlisted_practices: Single-arm feasibility testing of a patient-specific EHR-informed LLM chatbot for parents in the PICU, including sample size planning for a future RCT

screen.reason: Prospective single-arm feasibility study deploying an EHR-informed GPT-4o chatbot for parents in a PICU to measure engagement, provider perceptions, and safety without comparing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
